results.title: Get Into The Spirit
results.overview: While attempting to communicate with a handsome ghost haunting their house, two husbands discover there are many ways a spirit can reach out from beyond the grave.

results.title: A Christmas Ornament to Remember
results.overview: A big city veterinarian rushes home to help her family recover from a devastating storm and save the tree lighting, but finds her mission complicated when a mysterious Christmas ornament arrives and sets her back on a path back to love.

results.title: Poirot is a teenage girl and they killed her boyfriend
results.original_title: Poirot és una adolescent i li han matat el nóvio
results.overview: June 1985. When Veronica discovers her boyfriend's dead body in the pool after a high school house party, she decides to become a detective on par with Hercule Poirot and find out who the killer was.

results.title: Another Side of the Wall
results.overview: After graduating from university, Jiawei’s relationship fell into crisis. He chose to stay in Hong Kong, while his girlfriend insisted on returning to her home country to prepare for the civil service exam. Their long-distance relationship gradually wore down their feelings and patience, yet neither was willing to compromise for the other, and so things dragged on. Then one day, Jiawei heard the girl next door—a Hong Kong local—learning to play a guitar song, which happened to be his favorite. The sound of the guitar drifted through the thin wall of their subdivided flats into his empty room.

results.title: Ciclo de Lavado
results.overview: Marina and Lucía, two flatmates, discover a unique feature of their new washing machine.

results.title: Arzamas. Lullaby
results.overview: An essay on a return to the city of childhood, where private memories of a catastrophe, historical traces, and Leo Tolstoy’s night in Arzamas fold into an uneasy image of the place. Present-day Arzamas, archival testimony, staged images, and the author’s recollections sit in the film as separate layers of time. The night Tolstoy lived through in Arzamas opens a realm of dream, where the past meets a future that, for the author, has already become a memory. Little by little, from those layers, Arzamas appears — a beautiful, scarred city.

results.title: In Search Of The Higher Purpose
results.overview: An exploration of contemporary art drawing inspiration from the Russian tradition. At its centre is Nika Kletski, an Orthodox street artist. Creating works at the intersection of iconography, personal experience, and urban space, Nika seeks a new way of engaging in dialogue with contemporary audiences. Her art emerges where the past meets the present: on walls, in abandoned buildings, and in the cracks of familiar urban reality. The present is impossible without a memory of the past, while the search for a new artistic language begins with an attempt to find a balance between heritage, personal experience, and contemporary forms.

results.title: Black Ink
results.overview: A man refuses to open his mail.

results.title: Thunder Queens
results.overview: A portrait of young women artists turning the volume all the way up, finding power in connection, and making the stage feel possible for younger girls coming up behind them.

results.title: 1018 Months
results.overview: A biographical drama woven from documentary footage, reconstructions, and recollection. Galina Alexandrovna — heroine, mother, grandmother, actress of her own fate — lives through decades in which fact and invention intertwine. More than ten years of filming, from the hot summer of 2012 to her last summer in 2025, turn a private life into a myth. A story of memory stronger than death, of love, and of a refusal to vanish.

results.title: Waiting For The Savior
results.overview: The early 2020s were among the hardest years in the history of independent Armenia. In 2022, businessman Gagik Tsarukyan announced the construction of the world’s tallest statue of Christ, calling it a symbol of national revival. Armenians from every corner of the country take part in the project. The people wait… They wait for the Savior.

results.title: Disc
results.overview: An old external hard drive holds photographs of a father who is no longer there. Opening them, the director goes back into childhood — small scenes of family life, sounds, touches, and the image of a man who still lives in her memory. With the memories, the pain of loss returns as well.

results.title: Calendar
results.overview: A retired workaholic tries to put new meaning into his days. He comes across his wife’s tear-off calendar, with birthdays of friends and relatives marked. Calling people long since forgotten leads to consequences no one could have guessed.

results.title: Memory is Me?
results.overview: To get acquainted with her deceased dad, whom she never met, a filmmaker follows the traces of him in her mother’s memories and the artifacts that are left behind. Along the way, she writes letters to her father—letters that cannot be sent.

results.title: Morning Echo
results.overview: After months of silence, Gabriel wakes to find his ex-boyfriend, Omar, in his kitchen cooking breakfast as if nothing ever happened. As the morning unfolds, unspoken tensions and unresolved feelings rise to the surface, forcing Gabriel to confront whether intimacy can exist without truth, or if some things are better left in the past.

results.title: Faces
results.overview: After Eric dies, his three best friends are entrusted with breaking into his phone to delete its hidden contents. But what starts as a simple task unravels into a deadly nightmare…

results.title: Forget Me, Not
results.overview: Sadie relies on her fiancé Walt to fill in the substantial holes in her memory after a near-drowning, until a strange mark growing on her skin forces her to question if there’s more to the story.

results.title: Exit From The Lumière Factory
results.overview: The Lumières’ classic was shot in three takes. Statistically, over a working life, each worker leaves the factory some 9,000 times.

results.title: My Land
results.overview: Somewhere in the mountains there is a magic land that raises the dead. The protagonist sets out to find it and bring back his dead brother. The further he travels, the further he is from his goal.
